description: Recently, Washington Republican leader Jim Walsh argued that Democrats conducted a "raid on the police and fire pension fund." (See 6:10)I have also heard similar concerns from retired police officers and firefighters who believe money is being taken from the LEOFF 1 retirement system. Naturally, I wanted to understand what was really happening. My first question was simple: Are retirees seeing their monthly pension checks reduced?The answer appears to be no.
